paper.title_en: A class of half-BPS boundary conditions for $A_{K-1}$ circular quivers
paper.abstract_en: We study a string-motivated class of $\tfrac12$-BPS boundary conditions for 4d $\mathcal N=2$ $A_{K-1}$ circular quiver gauge theories with gauge group $SU(N)^K$, engineered by D4-branes suspended between NS5-branes on a circle. For D4-branes ending on a boundary D6-brane sent to infinity, a single-pole ansatz reduces the BPS equations to a constrained algebraic problem. We characterize the structure of its solutions, which exhibit a winding phenomenon with no analogue for linear quivers, and solve several cases explicitly in closed form. A brane-duality argument suggests looking for the S-dual of the pure Neumann boundary condition within this class. We show that the residual gauge symmetry can be discrete only under a condition fixed by tracelessness, in which case it is the centre $\mathbb Z_N$, and that solutions with this property exist for every $N$ and $K$.
